Biology 2011-II.subject: Biology
Biology 2011-II.question: Polar bears are carnivores and prey on many arctic birds and fishes. However, under natural conditions, no one found polar bears predating any penguin. This is because
options: penguins have chemical substance in their muscles which is toxic to polar bears
penguins are gregarious and always move in groups. Therefore, a polar bear cannot approach them
polar bears and penguins never coexist under natural conditions. The former lives in the North Pole while the latter lives in the South Pole
polar bears and penguins display symbiotic relationships  and  they  help  each  other  for  their existence in the ice-cold ecosystem
Biology 2011-II.answer: polar bears and penguins never coexist under natural conditions. The former lives in the North Pole while the latter lives in the South Pole
Biology 2011-II.explanation: (c)  Polar bears and penguins live in different polar regions i.e. polar  bears live in the North Pole while the penguins live in Antarctica (the Southern  Hemisphere).

Biology 2011-II.question: To suspect HIV/AIDS in a young individual, which one among the following symptoms is mostly associated with?
options: Long standing jaundice and chronic liver disease
Biology 2011-II.explanation: (d)  After 4-8 weeks of infection by HIV virus to a healthy individual, the acute phase of HIV infection begins. About 30-60% people develop symptoms like severe persistant headache with sore throat and mild fever etc.

Biology 2011-II.subject: Biology
Biology 2011-II.question: Development of goitre (enlarged thyroid gland) is mainly due to deficiency of
Biology 2011-II.explanation: (b)  The cause of goitre is normally due to lack of iodine. Iodine plays an important role in the synthesis of thyroxine hormone from thyroid gland.

Biology 2011-II.subject: Biology
Biology 2011-II.question: If we sprinkle common salt on an Earthworm, it dies due to
Biology 2011-II.explanation: (a)  The sprinkled salt dissolves in the water present on the moist skin of Earthworm and makes concentrated solution. The body fluid, being hypotonic, diffuses out and the worm dies due to osmotic shock (water loss- dehydration).

Biology 2011-II.subject: Biology
Biology 2011-II.question: It has been observed that astronauts lose substantial quantity of calcium through urine during space flight. This is due to
Biology 2011-II.explanation: (b)  Exposure to microgravity in the environment of space induces astronauts to lose calcium from bones. This loss takes place due to absence of ‘Earth gravity’ which disrupts the process of bone maintenance. The calcium is excreted out with urine.

Biology 2011-II.subject: Biology
Biology 2011-II.question: Which one among the following will be absorbed fastest through the wall of digestive system?
options: Black coffee as a hot beverage
Raw alcohol taken as a drink
Biology 2011-II.answer: Raw alcohol taken as a drink
Biology 2011-II.explanation: (c)  Raw alcohol after being drunk will be absorbed fastest through the wall of digestive tract. Alcohol is easily diffusible across the plasma membrance. It does not need any digestion before absorption in the alimentary canal. Therefore, its absorption begins from mouth, whereas the other substances are absorbed in the later parts of the alimentary canal.
